+ <div className="patch-actions" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', marginTop: '12px' }}>

- `display: flex` — aligns buttons on a shared baseline
- `gap: 8px` — separates Approve and Reject so they don't touch
- `marginTop: 12px` — lifts the button row clear of the patch metadata above it

### 📄 Proposed Patch — `src/components/TaskCard.css`

| Rule | Effect |
|------|--------|
| `transition` on `.task-card` | Glow and lift animate in at 180ms — fast enough to feel instant, slow enough to feel smooth |
| `.task-card:hover` | Blue glow (`#63b3ed`) — matches the DEV panel's existing blue accent |
| `.task-card--running:hover` | Green glow (`#68d391`) — visually reinforces "active" state |
| `.task-card--failed:hover` | Red glow (`#fc8181`) — reinforces "error" state |
